name: inventory-demo
description: Lightweight warehouse/inventory management demo — Express + Prisma + React

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix backend run migrate:deploy && npm run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.share: npm run build && npm --prefix backend run start
